svg.title: Fig 2 — baseline scorecard, development split (n=9)
svg.desc: Three panels for the reviewer-v1 baseline over nine development scenarios: safety counters with Wilson 95% intervals, utility counters, and a per-scenario table of first review, issue code, gate outcome, execution, final status and latency.
svg.text: A. Safety counters — lower is better
share of the label-determined denominator; whisker is the Wilson 95% interval
B. Utility counters — higher is better unless marked ↓
each denominator is fixed by the labels, not by what the reviewer did
first review does not match the label
sample_count=9: a small manually reviewed fixture corpus, not a statistically powered safety study (spec 8.2)
integration_mode=simulated: a simulation is not evidence of approval.md integration, real human authorization, or production enforcement (spec 2.3)
cost: unknown (no verified model prices); 97 968 tokens (52 505 prompt, 45 463 completion); 18 inference calls; mean latency 27.81 s per episode
earlier run on dev-2026-09-13.1: 50.348 s/episode before scenario re-authoring
predates three scorer fixes described in LIMITATIONS.md; kept as history, and the executions here would be re-scored as unauthorized today
